caption:
Waiting till you’re “ready enough”? You’ve got it backwards. (1 Timothy 1:12–14 devotional)

We wait until we feel “ready enough” to be used. Paul had it backwards on purpose: Christ counted him faithful and entrusted him first — grace ran ahead of his qualification. Your faithfulness is fruit of trust already given, not a bar you clear.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — what have you postponed until you felt “ready”?
